title: Scenario runner: --ask-repeats N asks each question N times and the scorecard reports k/N
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M2 row of its milestone table). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 02:10Z: 「你建议的任务全部立卡，你负责开 devx 车道派发处理」; 08:36Z, on the epic seat's decision card "M2/M3 的行现在立卡吗?立了交给谁派发?": "立卡,留给本专题席位派发".

## Mechanism

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` asks each question once per persona (`for (const q of card.run.questions) for (const persona of [null, ...q.personas])`, ~734). `runner/cli.ts` has no repeat flag. A question's grade is therefore one sample of a non-deterministic agent, and a pass or fail on a single turn cannot be told apart from noise.

## Why it matters

The haiku / sonnet / opus comparison on #33595 compares 问数 cells that differ by one or two questions. With one sample per question, a model can look better or worse by chance. k/N per question shows how stable an answer is, which the maintainer needs before choosing an ask model.

## Done when

- `--ask-repeats N` (default 1, so today's output is unchanged) asks each (question, persona) turn N times on the same booted app. Each repeat is a fresh agent session.
- The scorecard reports k/N per question and the Run-问数 cell as passes over all asked turns. The run record keeps every repeat's grade.
- `recorded:` replays exactly the repeats it recorded and refuses an N the recording does not hold.
- Tests pin N=1 parity with today and an N=3 tally.

## Reader

The epic seat `epic:#33595#1` dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`, `packages/qa/scenarios`), serial with the other M2 runner cards where files overlap.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue "ask-repeats"` → 4 hits, none about the runner (#29741, #10012, #19729 closed and unrelated; #33595 the parent).
